balls.text: smashed on the pads, and Bumrah finishes his evening's work with a wicket! Or does he? Jitesh has reviewed but that will be immaterial, in a run-scoring context! Searing yorker on middle and off. Jitesh, standing outside off, looks to sweep it away and gets hit on the back leg. Impact could be an issue, and impact is an issue according to Ball Tracking. Impact outside the line, and Jitesh will remain unbeaten!

in the slot, and Jitesh sends that ten rows back over long on! Bumrah errs, perhaps for the first time in this death-overs spell. Jitesh, sitting deep in his crease, gets under it and boshes it over long on!
back of a length, angling into middle and leg, and this completely flummoxes Jitesh. He was shaping for the scoop/sweep but the length does him all ends up
slanted into the blockhole on middle and leg. David jams down on it and with an open bat face, squeezes it out to deep point
low full toss on leg stump. Jitesh gets down low but still cannot get under it. Swipes it towards deep mid wicket

off the glove, and just short! A mix-up too and it is all happening here now! Sharp bumper on leg stump. Gets big on Jitesh and the ball scrapes his glove on the way. Rickelton, after taking a few steps forward, dives but cannot get there. David and Jitesh then have a slight mix-up and the end result is no run taken

goes straight up and Rickelton channels his inner Superman to snare that chance! Slanted across full outside off. Patidar shuffles across, trying to scoop it fine and gets a fat top edge. The ball goes a mile up and Rickelton calls for it early. Tracks it all the way and then lunges forward to complete the catch. This could be a big moment in this innings still, given how Patidar was going, but take nothing away from this blistering knock!
short and wide outside off. Patidar has a huge swish at it and only has a fresh-air shot. Called a wide
back of a length outside off. Jitesh stands up tall and hacks it towards long off
banged into the track outside off. Jitesh jumps up onto his toes and has a swish at it. Makes no contact whatsoever
six more - Jitesh is taking Boult apart in the 19th! Zipped in on a length on middle and off. Jitesh walks a great deal outside off and still manages to get down on one knee and lap it over fine leg!
low full toss wide outside off. Jitesh, sitting deep in his crease, drills it straight to extra cover

goodness gracious me - that is a shot and a half! Misses the wide yorker by a smidgen on the shorter side and Jitesh pounces. Gets down low, snaps his wrists into action and shovels it over deep mid wicket!
full and a country mile outside off. Jitesh shoulders arms and the umpire calls it a wide
full toss on middle and leg and Jitesh cannot capitalize on this as well. Tugs it towards deep mid wicket, and just six singles off the 18th!
back of a length outside off. Patidar stands up tall and clinks it right off the toe-end. Clears the bowler but only fetches a single to long off
full toss on middle and leg. Jitesh is a little late to pick this up and punches it past the bowler for a single. That was bowled at 136.6kph
low full toss on middle stump. Patidar cannot get under it enough and flicks it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
slower ball on a full length wide outside off. Jitesh has an ungainly hoick at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards square leg
full toss on leg stump. Patidar is a little late on the stroke and scuffs it towards deep backward square leg. He will feel he missed out there
edged and four! Everything going RCB's way now! Low full toss slanting into off stump. Jitesh looks to tug it over deep mid wicket and gets a leading edge that flies over short third instead!
into the blockhole just outside off. Patidar digs it out into the off side and Jitesh is alert enough to sneak in a single
full and wide outside off. Beyond the tramlines and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
four more! Patidar is on absolute fire, and MI have no answers whatsoever! Angled in on a length on middle and off. Patidar uses the angle and whips it away behind square over backward square leg!
Patidar is toying with Hardik Pandya now! This is shorter and perhaps wider outside off. Patidar knows that is coming and takes a step across his stumps to whack it over cow corner!

banged down the ground, and Patidar brings up his fifty in style! This is a slot ball outside off and this deserved to be smashed. Patidar extends his hands through the ball and pumps it into the sightscreen!
executes the wide yorker to perfection. Jitesh walks across early and digs it out towards sweeper cover

four more! Patidar inching closer towards fifty, and RCB powering closer towards 200! Attempted leg-stump yorker that goes wrong and ends up as a full ball on the pads. Patidar gets bat on it and tickles it away fine!
in the slot on the stumps. Patidar plants his front foot and lifts it over the bowler's head. Hardik tears around to his left from long on and reins it in
slower bumper outside off. Jitesh gets up on his toes and pulls it powerfully towards deep mid wicket. Having gotten hold of it, he will feel he missed out
sizzling shot to clear the fence! Another off-cutter, on a length wide outside off. Jitesh goes through the line and carves it just over the sweeper at deep cover!
Jitesh begins on his merry way! Slow, short and sitting up to be hit outside off. Jitesh leaps up into the air and scythes it over backward point!
fullish on middle and leg. Patidar gets onto the front foot and drives it uppishly towards long on

has Jitesh been run out?! Length outside off. Patidar gets forward and punches it past extra cover. The ball rolls towards long off and that prompts Jitesh to hare down for the second. Patidar, though, sends him back. Jitesh has to sprawl and that allows him to regain his ground!
oh my word - what a shot! Back of a length and wide outside off again. Patidar moves across early and then paddles it beautifully behind square!
full and wide outside off. Beyond the tramlines and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
back of a length outside off. Jitesh waits for it and opens his bat face to guide it towards deep backward point

goes straight up, and Bumrah takes it! Hardik has two in the over, and he is tilting this game his team's way! Back of a length and in another postcode to the stumps. But that is the plan Hardik is bowling too. Livingstone tries to manufacture a scoop behind square but gets it terribly wrong. Might have flicked the helmet on the way too, and that shank is easily pouched by Bumrah at short third. RCB lose two in quick succession, and MI have a bit of momentum!
back of a length, kissing the tramlines on the off side. Livingstone looks to lap it away, having shuffled across, but makes a complete mess of that attempt. The ball trickles into the off side
short and a mile outside off. Left alone by Livingstone and some more exercise for the umpire

Hardik gets the better of Kohli, and the Wankhede finds its collective voice! Back of a length delivery hung up wide outside off. Kohli, knowing there is space to access behind square on the leg side, walks across. Has a swipe at it but does not control it as well as he would have wanted. Miscues it and Dhir gobbles up the chance at deep mid wicket. A solid pace-setting knock, but now, someone else will have to take RCB past 200!
right out of the screws! Darted into the slot on middle and off, and guess what happens to those - they go miles. Patidar opens up his stance and smokes it clean over long off!
throws it up wide on a length. Kohli has to fetch it while stepping down and drags it into the mid wicket region

tossed up nicely on a length just outside off. Kohli advances, trying to smash it into next week and is beaten in the air by the flight. Gets a thick outside edge and gets two for his toil towards short third
shot! Shortens the length after seeing Kohli advance, but it does not matter to Kohli at all. He does not get to the pitch but still manages to thump it over the bowler's head!
even slower on a length on middle and off. Patidar backs away a touch and pushes it towards deep point
bam! Patidar is not hanging about after the time-out! Tossed up on a length on leg stump. Patidar gives himself swinging room and launches it over long on!
safe! Short and wide outside off. Patidar throws his hands at it and cuts it on the bounce to sweeper cover. On another day, that might have carried
back of a length outside off. Holds a little in the surface and Patidar scuffs it back towards the bowler
short, wide and punished! Not the greatest bit of bowling with short third in the ring. Patidar jumps up onto his toes and upper-cuts it over the keeper!
ouch! That will sting! Full and wide outside off. Patidar looks for the scoop again but this time, jams it straight into his grille. Patidar has a smile on his face, and let's hope he is alright
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Patidar holds his shape this time and chips it easily over extra cover
innovation at its best! Back of a length wide outside off. Patidar moves across his stumps early, gets down low and laps it beautifully over the keeper's head!
angled in on a length on leg stump. Patidar knocks it to long on and keeps strike
back of a length of a length, following Kohli outside leg. He punches it down the ground towards long off
Watch. The. Spin. A bit shorter but similarly slow, angling into off stump. Kohli backs away and slaps it towards long off. Dhir over-runs it to his left and cannot recover thereafter!
slowed up nicely on a full length on leg stump. Kohli has a massive swipe across the line and gets rapped on the pads
back of a length outside off. Kohli skips down the track and smashes it straight to extra cover. A yard either side and that might have been four
fired in very full on middle and leg. Patidar digs it out towards long off
slower ball on a length just outside off. Patidar comes onto the front foot and eases it to long on
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Patidar gets up on his toes and drops it right beside him. A bit of chat between Kohli and Bumrah - all in jest, though!
low full toss outside off. Kohli cannot get under it and clinks it off the toe-end towards long off
low full toss on middle and leg. Patidar flicks it towards deep mid wicket
banged into the track outside off. Kohli advances and hacks it towards long on. That got big on him
off-pace on a length on leg stump. Patidar tucks it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
pushed in full on the pads. Patidar glances it towards deep backward square leg
fired down leg on a back of a length. Patidar gets inside the line and lets it go. Called a wide
tossed up full on leg stump. Patidar comes onto the front foot and pokes it towards extra cover
back of a length on off. Patidar hangs back and stabs it towards mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. Patidar lets the ball come to him before placing it perfectly between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg. Off the mark with a brace
back of a length outside leg again. Kohli gets tucked up for the second ball running and pats it enough to extra cover's left for a single
back of a length, following the batter outside leg. Kohli gets cramped for room and taps it towards extra cover

goes a mile up, and Vignesh has a wicket! A vital, vital breakthrough and it is the youngster coming up with the goods! Flighted up enticingly on a fullish length on middle and leg. Padikkal thinks he can go downtown but the ball drops and dips on him late. He has to reach out in front, which leads to his bottom hand coming off. Cannot generate the requisite power and Jacks holds his nerve on the long on fence to do the rest. Sprightly cameo, and Padikkal will feel he has done his job here!
back of a length outside off. Kohli goes deep into his crease and eases it to long off
Kohli goes big, and he brings up a 29-ball half-century! Tossed up into the slot on middle and off. Kohli gets down on one knee and slugs it over wide long on!
pushed in very full just outside leg. Padikkal brings out the reverse and helps it past backward point for a single
dragged down on leg stump. Kohli hops back and hoicks it towards deep backward square leg
slanted in on a length on leg stump. Padikkal skips down the track and whisks it towards deep mid wicket
off-pace on a length outside off. Kohli gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards extra cover
slow and short outside off. Kohli nearly swishes himself off his feet and seems to miss it. There seemed to be a noise as the ball passed the bat but did not carry to Rickelton anyway
dug into the track outside off. Padikkal opens up his stance and heaves it towards deep backward square leg
angled in full on middle and off. Kohli comes onto the front foot and turns it towards deep mid wicket
zipped in very full just outside leg. Padikkal swishes at it and misses, and the ball rolls off his pads behind point
hard length, following the batter outside leg. Kohli stands up tall and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
darted in full on leg stump. Kohli works it towards deep mid wicket
smashed! Slower and landing right into the slot on off. Kohli gets down on one knee early and clobbers it over mid wicket. That was hit so firmly!
back of a length just outside off. Padikkal sits deep in his crease and eases it to long on
fired in fuller on middle and leg. Kohli knocks it down the ground to long on
slower and shorter outside off. Kohli, having backed away, has to reach out for it and jabs it straight to extra cover
back of a length on the pads. Padikkal tucks it away towards deep backward square leg
full outside off. Padikkal, sitting deep in his crease, punches it towards mid off and then hares across to the other end

streaky but they all count! Fuller and wider outside off, asking Padikkal to fetch it. He looks to go over mid on and gets it diametrically opposite to where he was aiming. He will not mind it one bit, though. Neither will RCB!
this is an even better stroke! Banged into the track outside off. Gets up near the back shoulder but Padikkal, somehow, manages to wallop it over deep mid wicket!
shot! A bit of a half-tracker outside off and this is just begging to be hit. Padikkal winds up, after picking the slower ball and slams it over mid on!
slower ball on a full length outside off. Kohli advances and flicks it towards long on
slower bumper just outside off, which is a riposte to Kohli advance. He gets out of the way hurriedly and the square leg umpire calls it a wide for height
off-pace on a length outside off. Padikkal gets forward and opens his bat face to dab it towards deep backward point
Kohli finds the fence yet again! This is a drag-down, spinning into Kohli's body. He gives himself further room and hammers it past deep mid wicket!
fired in on a length on off. Padikkal hangs back and eases it to long off
back of a length on middle and off. Kohli gets behind the line and knocks it to long on
back of a length, spinning into middle and leg. Kohli glances it towards short fine leg
oh, big spin! Back of a length, pitching outside off and then spinning a mile. Kohli is cut in half and gets rapped on the body
dispatched! Tossed up generously outside off and this lands right in the slot. Kohli extends his arms and bangs it over the bowler's head!
fullish just outside off. Kohli stretches forward and pokes it back towards the bowler, whose slight misfield allows a single
right into the blockhole on off stump. Kohli jams down on it and digs it out into the off side
shortish on off. Padikkal goes back and across before tucking it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on middle and off. Kohli uses the angle and turns it towards deep square leg
Kohli greets Bumrah with a trademark stroke! Marginally short on middle and off. Kohli backs away and swats that one away like it was a fly. Right on the cushion, and Kohli gets six!
on the money first up. On a length, angling into middle and off. Padikkal pushes it to mid on and scrambles across to the other end
sumptuous. Just sumptuous! Length outside off and Kohli climbs into this. Steps forward, shows the maker's name and creams it between extra cover and mid off!
four more! Kohli is turning it on now too! Back of a length on middle and leg. Sits up and Kohli rides with the bounce, using his bottom hand to short-arm jab it past mid wicket!
back of a length just outside off. Padikkal punches it to mid off and saunters across to the other end

just over the fence! Padikkal and RCB have their first six of the evening! Banged into the track on middle and off. Padikkal swivels and even though he does not middle it, he muscles it over Bumrah at deep backward square leg!
back of a length just outside off. Nips back in and Padikkal, up on his toes, stabs it towards mid on
back of a length just outside off. Kohli backs away, trying to go inside out but ends up chunking it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
hard length on off. Kohli advances, tries to force it through the off side but cannot get it past a diving Suryakumar at extra cover. Sharp work to his right
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Kohli looks to flick it away and squirts it off the inside edge towards long leg. Back for a brace
Kohli lands his first punch now! Back of a length just outside off. Kohli stands up on his toes and hacks it past mid wicket. Deep backward square leg was too fine to cut it off as well!
back of a length on middle and off. Kohli takes a step down the track and pushes it past mid wicket to get off the mark with a brace

massive lbw shout, not given! Back of a length, pitching just outside off and decking back in sharply. Kohli is caught on the crease and gets rapped on the pads. Chahar insisted, but the umpire was unmoved. Might have been high and also going down leg
length outside off, swinging away a touch. Kohli gets forward and drives it on the up towards extra cover. Nice timing on that by Kohli
angled in on a back of a length on middle and leg. Padikkal lets the ball come to him before tapping it towards mid wicket
back of a length in the channel and this moves away late. Padikkal has a nibble at it with minimal footwork and is beaten all ends up
fuller outside off. Padikkal gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards mid off
Padikkal starts off with a pristine boundary too! Length outside off. Shapes away but Padikkal accounts for it. Stays on top of the bounce and threads it between cover and point!

four and out! Boult breezes through Salt's defences and the Wankhede has something to cheer about very, very early! Full on middle stump and this curves back in beautifully. Salt looks to tug it away, perhaps aiming too square and only connects with fresh air. The ball sneaks past his blade and then leaves the stumps in an absolute mess. Salt livid with himself; Boult absolutely overjoyed, as are the thousands in blue at the ground. First blood to the Mumbai Indians!

oh, what a shot to kick things off! Boult goes searching for swing and over-pitches just outside off. Salt presses forward and blasts it between extra cover and mid off. Turns around, marks his guard and does not even bother to see where that has gone!

history for RCB! They conquered the Eden Gardens, they conquered Chepauk, and they have now gunned down the five-time champions at the Wankhede Stadium! A tense, tense finish, and the Mumbai Indians, having come so close yet again, fall short - that too in front of their fans, and to a team they had never lost to (at this venue) for almost a decade! This is slower and fuller on leg stump. Bumrah swings for the hills and misses. Gets rapped on the pads and that will be it. Cue the celebrations from RCB. A massive, massive win, and another statement of intent right at the start of the season. Another tough loss to digest for MI, though, and they will, especially having been turned over on their patch, be licking their wounds, long after this game is done!

taken on the fence, and Krunal roars in delight at what used to once be his home ground! Mumbai Indians now on the brink, and RCB on the verge of their third win in four games! Low full toss on leg stump. Dhir has no option but to swing at it. Gets it all wrong, though, and the ball loops up off the top edge towards deep backward square leg. Dayal does the rest, and Krunal is over the moon, as are the rest of his teammates. MI, meanwhile, crestfallen!
edged and four! Naman Dhir keeps MI breathing and they are alive by the barest of margins! Full and wide outside off. Dhir throws the kitchen sink at it and slices it over short third!
short ball on leg stump. Boult gets inside the line and swipes it all along the ground to deep backward square leg. Over to you, Naman Dhir!
oh dear - Krunal has bowled a wide! You have got to be kidding me! Slanted in full but also down leg. Boult falls over trying to access it but does not lift his back foot. Called a wide

oh, what a piece of fielding on the fence, and this is a moment of pure fielding magic right when RCB wanted it! Tests Chahar out with a bouncer first up. Chahar has a massive mow across the line and heaves it towards deep mid wicket. Salt runs around and then takes it over his head, while also being airborne. Soon realizes that he might step onto the ropes and parries it to David, who has followed up and completes the catch. Wow, this is some bowling and fielding under pressure!

straight to long off, and Krunal takes Santner out off the first ball of the 20th! Fired across the batter, full and wide. Santner gets under it but does not get under it enough. Flat as an arrow but David, stood like a tree at long off, clasps that between his giant palms. MI lose another, and they lurch further into trouble. RCB, on the other hand, can sense it. They can almost touch that previously-elusive win at the Wankhede!
low full toss on leg stump. Santner stoops down low and clinks it towards long on. Just a single, and that means Santner will be on strike for the start of the 20th
inside-out and done with the grace of Brian Lara in his pomp! Oh my - this game swings again! Low full toss outside off. Santner bends his back knee and then creams it over extra cover!
another excellent full ball on middle and leg. Dhir cannot get under it and has to stay content with a flicked single to long on
cracking yorker outside off. Dhir is a little late to catch up with it and by the time his bat comes down, the ball has whistled past the toe-end of his bat
full on the pads. Santner tucks it away towards deep backward square leg and Santner gets off the mark. Also gets Dhir back on strike, more pertinently

goes straight up and taken at deep mid wicket! Hazlewood rips open the game again, and Mumbai Indians hearts sink! Cometh the hour, cometh Josh Hazlewood! Slanted in very full on leg stump. Hardik looks to use his wrists to club it over wide long on. Gets a little cramped for room and only gets elevation. No distance on it and Livingstone accepts the offering with glee at deep mid wicket!
right up in the blockhole on middle and off, and that is an excellent response. Dhir jams down on it and digs it out towards the bowler
hold the pose, Naman Dhir! This is a shot and then some. Slot ball on middle and off. Dhir shows the maker's name and crrrrrrrrrunnnnnnchhhhhesssss it over the bowler's head!

Tilak falls trying to further up the ante, and RCB have broken this partnership! Slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Tilak tries to crash it over point but the lack of pace does for him. Gets under it too much and Salt, running in from sweeper cover, makes no mistake at all. Tilak walks off for a blazing 56, but he falls just short of getting the job done!
low full toss angling into the pads. Hardik cannot get under it and squeezes it out to deep square leg
flayed away for four! What a shot that is! Misses the yorker by probably a few centimetres and pays the price. Hardik slices at it and sends the ball racing to the deep point fence!
zipped in full on middle and leg. Hardik plants his front foot and tugs it enough to long on's right for a couple of runs
brilliant yorker to end the over, slanting into leg stump. Tilak plays all around it and the ball skims the pad on its way through to the keeper. Top ball to end the over!

kaboom! Tilak reads that like the morning daily and clobbers it! The length is not great either, sitting up outside off. Tilak has all the time in the world to dump it into the stands over wide long on!

another slower bumper outside off that just does not arrive. Tilak holds his shape much better on this occasion and swats it towards deep mid wicket. Brings up his fifty and after what happened in Lucknow, this has been a stunning knock!
very full outside off. Tilak sits deep in his crease and powers it towards sweeper cover. Krunal puts in the dive and saves two, but might have done himself some mischief
slow and short outside off, and this just does not arrive. Tilak plays three strokes in his head and then misses with his fourth and actual attempt, which was a square cut. That was bowled at 106kph
full toss on leg stump. Hardik opens up his stance and tugs it all along the ground towards long on
watch out, umpire! Bhuvneshwar misses the yorker by a smidgen just outside off. Tilak tees it up and bludgeons it back past the bowler. The umpire had to duck for cover too!

well well, not sure how to describe that! Back of a length ball a mile outside off. Tilak initially shapes for the scoop and then changes his shot mid-way. Tries the cut in the end and misses. Called a wide as well

a crack off the bat, and that has flown all the way! Back of a length, slanted well across the batter outside off. Tilak, though, fetches it and because his back knee is bent, he gets under it too, shoveling it over deep mid wicket!
another excellent yorker on leg stump. Hardik cannot get under it and digs it out towards long on
sizzling yorker tailing into leg stump. Hardik is a little late to bring his bat down and chunks it off the inside edge into his boot
into the blockhole on off. Tilak jams down on it and squeezes it out towards long on
short and wide outside off. Tilak swishes himself off his feet and only connects with fresh air. Touch-and-go on the wide, and the umpire is happy with it

oh dear! Banged into the track outside leg. Tilak has a swipe at it and seems to miss it. The umpire does not signal anything either. Did that hit the back of the bat then as Tilak swung at it? Might have
on a length on leg stump. Tilak lets the ball come to him and tugs it between deep backward square leg and deep mid wicket for a brace
short and wide outside off. Hardik waits for it and slaps it towards deep cover. Just a single, and the Pandya brothers share a chat after the run is completed
speared in fuller but still outside the tramlines on the off side. Hardik shoulders arms and Krunal will have to reload
fired in way outside off. Beyond the tramlines and the umpire calls it a wide
Hardik lands another massive blow on Krunal! Angled into the slot on leg stump. Hardik works it out early, drops down to one knee and whacks it over deep square leg. Top-tier stuff again!
Hardik is batting like a man possessed! Slot ball wide outside off and Hardik goes after it. Gets his hands through the ball nicely and clatters it a mile over wide long off!
full just outside off. Tilak plants his front foot and drills it down the ground to long off
nails the wide yorker to cap off the over. Hardik cannot jam down on it and the ball sneaks under the toe-end of the bat
Hazlewood is travelling now! Back of a length just outside off. Hardik gets on top of the bounce, peels the outer cover off the ball and knifes it between backward point and short third!
banged into the track outside off and this balloons over the batter's head. Left alone by Hardik and called a wide
oh my goodness! Hardik is on a roll very early in his innings! Slower ball on a length outside off. Hardik sits deep in his crease and plunders this over wide long off!
follows up the six with a four! Off-pace on a back of a length on off. Hardik picks the slower one just in time and heaves it between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg!
oh, hello! Oh, hello! Back of a length on middle and off. Hardik stands up tall, opens up his front hip and smears it over wide long on!
hard length on middle and leg. Skips off the surface and Tilak is late on the pull, shanking it into the square leg region for a single
darted in on a length on midle and off. Tilak goes deep into his crease and nudges it towards deep mid wicket
Tilak well and truly on the charge now! Given a bit of air on a length outside off. Tilak picks the googly early and reverse-sweeps it with aplomb over short third!
fired in full just outside leg. Tilak gets down on one knee and sweeps it fiercely towards deep backward square leg. Back for a brace
gorgeous batting! Thrown up full and wide, and now, Tilak is sweating on it. Excellent extension of the arms and he crashes it over cover!
kaboom! Tilak lands a blow! On a length just outside off. Tilak gets down on one knee early and clubs it over the wide long on fence!
floated up full and wide. Tilak looks for the inside-out drive but cloths it right off the toe-end. Straight to extra cover too

SKY with another miscue, and this time RCB make no mistake whatsoever! Slower ball hung up on a length wide outside off. SKY skips down the track and looks to go inside out. Cuts across it too much and that brings Salt into play at mid off. He back-pedals, keeps his eyes on the ball and pouches it. Dayal is off on his celebratory run again and nearly runs straight to Marine Drive. He is pumped. RCB are pumped too. MI, staring down the barrel!
hard length outside off. Skids onto Tilak and he hacks it towards long off
oh my goodness - that is a shot and a half! Slower ball on a length wide outside off. Tilak waits for it and then lays into it, smashing it flat over the deep cover fence!
full outside off. Tilak throws his hands at it and driills it towards extra cover. Another dot

goes straight up, and RCB make an absolute hash of it! Oh dear! Slower ball on a length on middle and off. SKY has a swipe across the line and gets a big leading edge. The ball touches the moon and comes back and when it does, Jitesh and Dayal, going for the same catch, contrive to grass it. That should have been a straightforward chance, but Dayal ran in circles, and Jitesh took it off Dayal's hands in the end!
back of a length outside off. Tilak gets up on his toes and slaps it towards extra cover. David snaps down sharply to his right and saves three
back of a length just outside off. More skid off the surface and SKY can only jab it straight to backward point

did that carry? That might have, and could go down as a missed chance! Floated up full on off. SKY gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep mid wicket. Krunal moves around to his right but then seems to lose it in the lights. Gets nowhere near the ball in the and, and it bobbles past him into the fence!
shortish outside off. SKY sits deep in his crease and cuts it straight to backward point

fizzed in on a length just outside leg. Tilak looks for the sweep over short fine leg and misses. The ball scrapes the pad and rolls away behind square. Suyash was interested in the lbw but no one else really was
back of a length just outside leg. Skids onto Tilak and raps him on the pad much before his bat comes down
slides this down leg. Tilak misses his sweep and once that happens, the umpire decides to indulge in some exercise
googly on a back of a length outside off. Tilak stays back and jabs it towards cover
back of a length just outside off. Tilak hangs back and squirts it off the inside edge into the on side
oh, hello! Dragged down outside off and because Tilak does not pre-meditate, he can cash in. He hangs back and eases it between extra cover and cover!

Krunal bowls the bouncer, and Jacks bites the dust! Proper bumper, bowled like a seamer and finishing on off stump. Jacks is taken by surprise and cannot get a hold of it. Tugs at it and spoons it towards deep backward square leg. Kohli makes no mistake and RCB have something to show for their middle-overs squeeze. That was bowled at 117kph, and MI are losing their way now!
excellent wide yorker and Jacks is all at sea. Cannot jam down on it and that is yet another dot

Jitesh is very interested in the stumping, and we go upstairs! Darted in very full outside off, perhaps pre-empting the reverse. Jacks cannot make contact and then there is a small moment where he seems to over-balance. Did he lift his back foot, and did Jitesh whip off the bails at precisely that moment? The back foot did come up, but Jitesh could not take the bails off in time!
back of a length, following the batter outside leg. SKY works it towards deep mid wicket
another swing and miss! Thrown up full and wide, and Jacks cannot get a hold of this. Tries to go leg-side and the purchase off the surface is enough to beat him
oh! Back of a length in and around off. Jacks opens up his stance and has a huge mow across the line. Jams it off the inside edge into his body
length outside off. SKY gets down on the sweep again and clinks it towards deep mid wicket
leg-spinner on a length outside off. SKY has another hack across the line, while being down on one knee, and only swats away a few flies
the good'ol slog does on this occasion! Fired in fuller just outside off. SKY gets down on one knee and drags it, finding the gap to deep backward square leg's left!
fizzed in on a length just outside off. Spins away a smidgen and that takes it past SKY's swipe. He was looking for that favoured sweep of his again
back of a length on middle and off. Grips a touch in the surface and straightens. Jacks gets squared up and prods it towards extra cover
splits the field perfectly! Pushed in on a back of a length on middle and off. Jacks unfurls the reverse and places it adeptly between backward point and short third!
back of a length on the pads. SKY helps it round the corner towards deep backward square leg
lovely, lovely batting! Fired in on a length on middle and off. SKY steps outside leg again and despite the ball sticking a little, he goes through with the shot, caressing it over extra cover!
what timing! Back of a length just outside leg. SKY gives himself room early and with a straight bat, thumps it past long on!
back of a length on middle and leg. Jacks backs away and jabs it towards sweeper cover
short and wide outside off. Jacks gets onto the back foot and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length on middle and off. Skids onto the batter and SKY hacks it towards deep mid wicket

huge, huge shout for a caught-behind, but the umpire is unmoved again! And RCB review just in the nick of time! Fizzed in on a length outside off. SKY looks for that trademark sweep of his and seems to miss it. There is a noise as the ball passes the bat, although that could have been off the back pocket too. Replays come up, and the ball has missed the bat, with the ball flicking the back thigh. The impact, in lbw terms, is also well outside the line and RCB lose a review!
back of a length on middle and leg. Jacks hangs back and pokes it towards long on
just short! Half-tracker outside off. SKY throws his hands at it and nearly slices it straight to backward point. Lucky that landed just in front of Krunal
back of a length outside off. Jacks goes back and knocks it back past the bowler for a single
back of a length on off. Jacks gets behind the line and works it enough to mid wicket's left to keep strike
very full on leg stump. SKY digs it out towards mid on and canters across to the other end
sharp bumper just outside off. Climbs off the surface and gets big on SKY as he looks to upper-cut it. Beaten for pace there
hard length again, in and around off stump. SKY has a wild swipe across the line and only connects with fresh air. That was not far away from the stumps either
hard length just outside off. No room to work with for SKY and he stabs it straight to mid off
back of a length just outside off. SKY gets up on his toes and jabs it back at the bowler, who gets a hand to it
stand and deliver! A touch on the shorter side outside off and once Jacks picks the length, this becomes a hit-me ball. He stands tall and whacks it over mid on!
slower ball on a full length on the pads. Jacks flicks it uppishly towards deep backward square leg and saunters back for two
hard length on the stumps. SKY punches it towards the bowler, who gets his left hand to it but cannot stop it clean, allowing a single
back of a length on middle and off. SKY rises with the bounce and stabs it towards mid off
SKY is off the mark! Back of a length on leg stump. SKY lets the ball come to him and then uses the pace to clip it past mid wicket!
back of a length just outside off. Jacks punches it towards mid off and scampers across to the other end
slanted in full just outside off. SKY presses forward and pokes it down the ground towards mid on
full just outside off. SKY gets onto the front foot and drives it straight to mid off

massive lbw shout, but the umpire says no! Was there bat involved? RCB deliberate and then they go upstairs! Length ball that may or may not have pitched in line with leg stump. Continues on with the angle and seems to rap Rickelton on the back leg as he misses his swish across the line. There is a gap between bat and ball, and this could be very close now. Pitching in line, impact in line and the ball is going on to hit middle and off stump. Rickelton has to go, and that is an excellent review by RCB!

short, wide and Rickelton cashes in! A nothing short of delivery. Neither short to trouble Rickelton, nor close enough to make him play a risky stroke. He frees his arms and pummels it past extra cover!
length just outside off. Rickelton presses half forward, stays on top of the bounce and taps it towards cover point
full just outside off. Rickelton gets onto the front foot and stabs it towards cover point. Just a hint of movement away
pushed in on a length just outside off. Jacks gets a half stride in and plays it back towards the bowler
back of a length on leg stump. Rickelton tips it to mid on and calls for the single early. Makes it comfortably enough in the end
back of a length on leg stump. Rickelton lets the ball arrive before tucking it off his pads towards mid wicket
that is another classy, classy stroke! On a length but the width is the problem again. Rickelton leans into the drive and caresses it between extra cover and cover point!
shot! Back of a length and offering width. Rickelton waits for it, gets his hands through the ball and crashes it to extra cover's left!
oh! Full ball that starts on off and shapes back in nicely. Rickelton looks to drive and chunks it off the inside edge into his pads
loose ball, and put away! Dayal goes for the magic ball, swinging into leg stump but errs too far down leg. Jacks gets the faintest of tickles and the ball hurtles away to the fine leg fence!
length ball swinging across the batter outside off. Jacks goes nibbling at it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge

Dayal with a superb riposte, and leg stump has been flattened! Rohit, after those early fireworks, has to go, and Dayal is off on his celebratory run! Full and swinging into middle and leg. Rohit looks to go down the ground but does not account for it as much. Might have grazed the inside edge but the end result is that leg stump is out of its groove. Massive early wicket, and the Wankhede crowd has been stunned!
ufff, that has raced to the fence like a tracer bullet! Back of a length outside off and this sits up to be hit. Rohit stands up tall on his toes and cracks it past extra cover!
Rohit with another boundary! Length ball on the pads and that is easy pickings for Rohit. He picks it up and muscles it over mid wicket!
back of a length, pitching on middle stump and then leaving the batter with the angle. Rohit has a long, hard look at it and shoulders arms
Rickelton off the mark with a boundary too! Length on middle and leg, shaping into Rickelton. He presses forward and check-drives it past mid on!
back of a length outside off. Moves away and Rohit uses that swing to cut it towards deep backward point
Rohit lands his first blow! Back of a length, angling into middle and off. Rohit picks the length early, establishes a solid base and whips it over the deep square leg fence!
fullish outside off. Rohit gets onto the front foot and defends
very full ball following Rohit outside leg. Having stepped down, Rohit takes it on the full and flicks it towards deep backward square leg. Dayal misfields, and that allows Rohit to get back for two
edged and just short! Length ball in the channel and this swerves away beautifully. Rohit nibbles at it and fortunately for him, does so with soft hands. Lands just in front of slip
